title: Fix the latency percentiles and histogram buckets
acceptanceCriteria: `percentile` sorts numerically, on a copy — the caller's array keeps its order
`percentile` uses a 1-based nearest rank: p50 of 101…200 is 150, p99 is 199, p100 is 200, and p50 of 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 is 30
`toBuckets` is cumulative: each `le` counts every sample at or below it, and the `Infinity` bucket counts them all
`fractionWithin` answers only at an existing bucket bound and returns `null` otherwise
`summarize` reports the tail the mean hides: mean 49.8 ms but p99 2,000 ms for 98 × 10 ms + 2 × 2 s
A 99%-within-300-ms check computed from `toBuckets` output gives 0.995 for the sample day
